device-add.title: Add your headset
device-add.body: Click Add device to register the headset you will use with patients.

device-name.title: Name it
device-name.body: Give the headset a name you will recognise, like "Device One".

device-submit.title: Add it
device-submit.body: Press Add Device. The headset shows up in your list.

device-pair.title: Start pairing
device-pair.body: Press Pair to get a 6-digit code for the headset.

device-code.title: Enter the code in the headset
device-code.body: Put the headset on and enter this code. The card shows Paired once it matches.

patient-add.title: Start a new patient
patient-add.body: Click New Patient to open the patient form. You will find it here whenever you add a patient.

patient-name.title: Write the full name
patient-name.body: Type the patient’s full name here. It is how you will find them later.

patient-sex.title: Pick their sex
patient-sex.body: Choose an option from this list.

patient-language.title: Pick their language
patient-language.body: The headset speaks to the patient in this language.

patient-submit.title: Save the patient
patient-submit.body: Everything else is optional. Press Create to add the patient.

program-add.title: Start a new program
program-add.body: Click New program to build an exercise program. You will find it here whenever you add a program.

program-choice.title: Choose how to start
program-choice.body: A starter template is quickest. You can also pick exercises yourself.

program-template-list.title: Pick a template
program-template-list.body: Click a template to preview its exercises on the right.

program-template-continue.title: Open it in the editor
program-template-continue.body: Press Continue to editor. Nothing is saved yet.

exercise-filters.title: Filter the catalog
exercise-filters.body: Pick a body part to see only its exercises. Equipment and search below narrow it down further.

exercise-card.title: Add an exercise
exercise-card.body: Click a card to add it to the program, and click it again to take it out.

program-catalog-continue.title: Review your picks
program-catalog-continue.body: Add as many exercises as you need, then press this button.

program-name.title: Name the program
program-name.body: Write a name you will recognise when starting a session, like "Knee rehab week 1".

exercise-row.title: Tune each exercise
exercise-row.body: Change sets, reps and the other settings here. The arrows move an exercise up or down the list.

program-submit.title: Save it to your library
program-submit.body: Press Submit. The program is ready to use in any session.

session-patient.title: Pick a patient
session-patient.body: Click the patient you are treating.

session-program.title: Pick a program
session-program.body: Choose one of your programs, or Quick Start to pick exercises on the fly.

session-headset.title: Pick the headset
session-headset.body: Put the headset on the patient and choose it here.

session-launch.title: Launch
session-launch.body: Press Launch on headset. The session opens on the patient dashboard.

expiredUpgrade.description: Your access has ended. Subscribe to a plan to start VR programs again. You can keep browsing Console while you decide.
